core_values.name: Science-Led, Human-Centred
core_values.tagline: Grounded in evidence, inspired by empathy.
core_values.body: Our work is guided by scientific rigour — data, research, and evidence — and always translated into human terms. Sustainability is not just a technical discipline; it needs empathy, storytelling, and cultural understanding to inspire change.

core_values.name: Integrity & Transparency
core_values.body: We operate with honesty, fairness, and openness in every relationship and engagement. From strategy design to reporting, we communicate truthfully — including when the answer is inconvenient.

core_values.name: Impact Driven
core_values.body: We partner with clients and communities by understanding their specific challenges, and deliver measurable environmental and social outcomes — in the interests of our clients, society, and the planet.

core_values.name: Kaizen
core_values.tagline: Because good is not good enough when better is possible.
core_values.body: Lasting change comes from small, steady steps done well. We refine our approaches, invite feedback, and hold the highest standards of quality, professionalism, and ethics in everything we do.

team_members.name: Vinit Gosalia
team_members.bio: IIT Kanpur–trained in climate finance, Vinit aligns strategy, disclosures, and stakeholder programmes to deliver credible results and measurable impact.

team_members.name: Trupti Sawant
team_members.bio: IIT Kanpur–trained in climate finance, Trupti scaled operations at Nokia and HERE Technologies, pioneering India's digital mapping. She turns complex sustainability challenges into robust systems and business-ready execution.
